scope: Independent static source/test comparison against full retained assembly for 0x18006f050 and 0x18006f0e8; no source modification and no target execution
checks: 06f050:257-byte clear precedes initial identity materialization, two QWORD zeroes and six WORD zeroes; 257 type bytes then 256 mapping bytes copied as individual read/write pairs. Fixtures cover self and one-byte-overlap copies.
06f0e8:CP65001 short-circuits GetCPInfo; GetCPInfo failure selects ASCII upper/lower fallback preserving unrelated type bits and EOF.
06f0e8:input 0 is space; each nonzero-start lead pair masks its inclusive bounded range; end-zero and reversed pair do not terminate later pairs; MaxCharSize is intentionally unused in this body.
06f0e8:CP reloaded before each of three downstream calls; locale reloaded before each map call; flags1/0x100/0x200, size256 and zero context/error flags match assembly.

Return statuses of classification/maps are ignored. WordOutput/ByteOutput retain undefined-output boundary; only selected mapping cell is consumed. Tests include failed-return with supplied data and unclassified bytes with omitted maps.
Uppercase bit1 wins over lowercase bit2. OR0x10/0x20 precedes selected map cell load; every mapping result is written.

Native callback spans and cells are explicit reconstruction contracts, not an ABI claim. Unterminated CPInfo and consumed undefined output throw explicit boundary exceptions rather than invent original stack contents.
limitations: Static review and synthetic fixtures do not establish original native API output, SEH/security-cookie/concurrency behavior.
No complete native DLL or locale/global initializer completeness claim.
